text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The clinical picture of progressive gait difficulty, urinary incontinence, speech slurring, limb rigidity, and orthostatic hypotension is highly suggestive of a specific neurodegenerative condition. Before finalizing the diagnosis, I need to know if you have experienced any significant changes in bowel habits or a loss of voluntary bowel control in addition to your urinary symptoms.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA)
